row.name: Mama Rana's for Play and Learn

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The 2009 van that was purchased in 2022 was not equipped with a child safety alarm at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that operation was found non-compliant with this standard as a caregiver was seen yelling at children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: 1 caregivers CPR  training certificate showed that CPR was completed online. CCR does not accept CPR online certificates.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: 1 caregiver's CPR First Aid training certificate was expired with an expiration date of 12/2024.  Director was unable to locate her CPR/FIRST AID certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Caregiver hired in 2022 lacked 13.5 traninng hours for training year 11/16/2023-11/16/2024
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: Director only has 10 of the 30 required training hours for training year 9/15/2023-9/15/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: At the time of inspection,Director lacked 1 hour training in the following topic: Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma; (2)Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and  (3)Understanding early childhood brain development
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Storage: At the time of inspection, the operation failed to maintain 3 months worth of playground maintenance checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Storage (26 TAC §746.803(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment: At the time of inspection, Director lacked 1hour training in the following topic: prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 4month old infant was asleep in a crib with rolled blankets used as props to keep the child on its side and covered with blankets with a bib around its neck. This was corrected at inspection by having the caregiver remove all items from from the crib including the bib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Caregiver with a start date of 3/2022 has only 3.5 hours of training for training year 3/2023-3/2024, avaliabe for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: At the time of inspection, Director lacked training in the following topics:(1) Emergency Preparedness (2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations;  (3)Administering medication;  (4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction;  (5)Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic; and  (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: At the time of inspection, CPSC form has a completion date of 3/31/2022. This was corrected at inspection by updating the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The operation did not have proof of 4 staff, including the director training certificates on file at the time of inspection.     The director who is the driver did not have transportation training as well.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The operations  fire inspection was expired with an inspection date of 9/21/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit was missing  guide to first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: According to drills logs kept by the operation, exit times for drills are not completed within 3 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: There were two expired topical medications in the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Personnel files were missing information to include date of employment, proof of education, &  verification the   employee is free of active tuberculosis (TB test).      Two of the caregivers are no longer working at the operation.  One caregiver still needs proof of education on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of the five children's records evaluated did not have an immunization record on file.      Immunization record was provided for one of the two children.  One child still needs a current immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Three children's records lacked the required admission information.      Two of the children's records were updated to include the admission information that was missing.  One child's record still needs to be updated to include the required admission information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: The director's 30 clock hours of annual trianing for the previous training year (9/20 - 9/21) was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: The operation did not have a current Children's Product Certification form on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: A copy of the most recent health inspection was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not include information regarding Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Personnel files were missing information to include date of employment, proof of education, &  verification the   employee is free of active tuberculosis (TB test).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: The toddler classroom did not have an activity plan posted.  The pre-k and school age classrooms did not have a current activity plan posted. The plans that were posted were from January and February.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Three children's records lacked the required admission information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of the five children's records evaluated did not have an immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The operation did not have a current employee list posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))
